summary: A program without TLS loads a DLL with static TLS (static C runtime) by LoadLibrary while a second thread waits: the DLL's TLS index is 1; TEB.ThreadLocalStoragePointer is set before the load and keeps its value; the loading thread (after DllMain), the thread started before the load and one started after it each read their own copy of the template with its zero fill, in the block their slot holds.
applicability: windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C)
